assessment.basis: Reproduction of the stored independent Peritheos refit under its declared protocol.
qualifications: This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.

Registered independent refit point estimates reproduce within the declared numerical solver tolerance. Replay of the registered independent Peritheos refit's stored point estimates, with numerical relative tolerance 1e-6 and absolute tolerance 1e-8 in the recorded units. This is solver repeatability, not agreement with source-author coefficients or an uncertainty estimate. Source-data limitations, graphical correlations and original-publication findings remain unchanged. Earlier audit wording (superseded only for the named numerical scope):

fit.comparison_scope: Compared free coefficients: K0, K0_prime; scope=independent_refit

locations: Sun et al. (2010), equations (3) and (20), Tables 2-3
primary_source_check.finding: The handbook prints 25 populated Cu V/V0 values from 15 to 340 kbar. The 15 kbar cell is a confirmed printing error, 09900, interpreted as 0.9900. Sun et al. define the Vinet model, hold experimental V0 fixed, and state the m=8 pressure-residual objective.
primary_source_check.record_note: V0 is the Sun et al. (2010) Table 2 Cu volume; K0 and K0' are Peritheos fits to the 25 Cu values of Table 4d-12 (p. 4-100) with the m = 8 objective of Sun equation (20). The 15 kbar entry, printed 09900, is read as 0.9900.

source_locations: Kennedy and Keeler (1972), Table 4d-12, Cu column, 15-340 kbar
primary_data_check.finding: All 25 populated finite-pressure Cu cells were manually verified and are checksummed. The refit is reproducible from the stored limited transcription.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Kennedy and Keeler (1972), Table 4d-12 and section 4d-2: the refitted isotherm is reduced from compiled shock measurements. Derived handbook rows are not raw observations, but their origin is experimental.

parameter_provenance.K0: Peritheos refit to the checked AIP Handbook Table 4d-12 Cu rows
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Peritheos refit to the checked AIP Handbook Table 4d-12 Cu rows
parameter_provenance.fit_objective: Sun et al. equation (20), unweighted eighth powers of pressure residuals with m=8
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: 25 degree C (298.15 K), Kennedy and Keeler Table 4d-12
parameter_provenance.catalog_action: separate Peritheos refit; published source-author coefficients retained unchanged
